metadata.description: Verbatim recall across Claude Code sessions, a recap when the context is compacted, and gates against work that costs more than it should.

plugins.name: inmemory
plugins.description: Gives Claude Code back the exact words from past sessions instead of a summary of them. When the context is compacted, hands back the thread that was just summarised away. Declines a re-read of a file that has not changed, and an oversized skill load. Automatic throughout, and silent when it has nothing worth saying. No dependencies, no API calls, nothing leaves your machine.
